title: Apollo 13 zapped because of a nuclear device

tellings.quote: I found out um that um Apollo 13 may not have failed by a mechanical problem. It may have been zapped by the aliens because they may have had a nuclear warhead on board.

plain: A man named Steve Coburn told podcast host Jesse Michels that he learned Apollo 13, the American Moon mission of 1970 that went wrong, may not have failed because of a mechanical fault. He says it may have been zapped by aliens because it may have carried a nuclear warhead, and he points to the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency that oversaw nuclear matters. If true, it would mean aliens actively stop nuclear weapons from going into space.
